system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: all roles share the same Qwen3-4B or Qwen3-8B model and are differentiated only by role-specific system prompts and decoding settings
system_prompt_style.note: Role-specific prompts per agent; rendering mechanism not described. No code released.

env_context_strategy.note: RS image inputs are passed to agents; no repository-context mechanism is described.

observation_format.note: Final answer is 'Text + Log file + images'; the format of tool observations is not specified.

tool_call_format.note: The paper says each specialist outputs a structured tool call u_t=(tool,args), but the syntax is not specified.

tool_count.note: Figure 2 shows 42 + 18 + 60 tools partitioned across the three specialists. The count is benchmark-environment tools, and no code is available.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP tool service interface and tool registry
tool_schema_source.note: This is an unreleased item in the Release Plan.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: including the Manager Layer, Specialist Layer, MCP tool service, Expert-tuning, and VG-HRL optimization

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The workflow then proceeds through iterative execution, verification, and adaptive correction until task completion.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the Manager Layer formulates sub-goals and constraints, routes each sub-goal to an appropriate specialist agent

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The Manager Layer is instantiated as a singleOrchestrator Agent (OA), which serves as the core controller of HiRS-Agent.
multi_agent_topology.note: The paper calls this hierarchical, but it has two levels with one orchestrator, which maps to orchestrator_workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the OA and specialist agents are prompt-conditioned role instantiations of the same back- bone policy

short_term_state.evidence_quote: H𝑡 is organized as a structured and queryable memory that stores: (i) task context, (ii) routing states, (iii) execution traces, and (iv) intermediate evidence.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The verifier performs three complementary checks: (i) schema validity, ensuring required fields and types are satisfied, (ii) sub-goal consistency
self_verification.note: The verifier is the OA role of the same shared backbone.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: FAIL triggers replan-on-failure, including tool repair, alternative rout- ing, or sub-goal adjustment
retry_policy.note: This retry is at step level. Whole-task retries are not described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: 𝑐𝑡 determines the next action (e.g., continue, replan, verify, or terminate)

tracing.evidence_quote: all intermediate results, including failures and re- covery traces, are stored inH𝑡
